policy: Every exported *Action function in a top-level use-server module and every exported POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE route handler is inventoried from the TypeScript AST. Caller-controlled FormData, request bodies, and route parameters require Zod parsing before mutation. Exceptions are exact boundary IDs, never path globs.

allowlist.reason: The MCP endpoint delegates bounded JSON-RPC envelope, protocol-version, session, tool-name, and per-tool argument validation to its MCP protocol dispatcher before any selected tool can mutate state.
The MCP endpoint accepts no body mutation payload; its custom boundary validates authorization and an opaque server-issued MCP session identifier before deleting that exact session.
The React action signature supplies FormData, but the implementation explicitly discards it and derives the only mutation target from the authenticated current membership context.
